title: How One Verse Before Breakfast Changes How a Man Reacts at Noon
caption:
Most men react at noon out of whatever they fed first at 7. If the first thing is a screen, noon belongs to the screen.

Pick the verse tonight, read it before the phone wakes up, carry one line, and use it when your jaw tightens.

What's the moment you usually blow it?

#faith #scripture #godlymen #christianman #psalm119
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
